{"parentUuid":"326353b6-0adb-416c-bd16-b2c817308b1b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8FuUhLW3XhC4U3u5d8E","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01T2jmGT24YFY3uPXCnoZ4jh","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"git push -q origin HEAD 2>&1 | tail -2; cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/8e04d881-36e8-4648-80fb-a97808a23dee/scratchpad/pr-body.md <<'EOF'\n## Summary\n\nThe Site build now writes the public site from Published Guides, in Chinese and English. The Admin-only **更新网站** button builds the site and puts it online.\n\n```text\nsite/\n├── index.html          # sends Readers to zh/\n├── style.css\n├── zh/  and  en/       # same shape; en/ has only Guides with English text\n│   ├── index.html      # Current Patch, newest Guides, Hero grid\n│   ├── guides/<slug>/  # one per Guide\n│   ├── heroes/<slug>/  # Guides grouped by Patch, newest first\n│   └── authors/<id>/   # Display name only, never the email\n```\n\n```text\nPOST /admin/site-build  (Admin only, CSRF)\n  publish.build_site()\n    render_site()\n    deploy()            # ghp-import push; raises DeployFailed with git's message\n    record the Site build only if the push succeeded\n  flash success or failure → dashboard\n\ndashboard: \"N 项更改尚未更新到网站\" = Published Guides changed since the last successful Site build\n```\n\n- **Language switch:** links to the same page in the other language. On a Chinese-only Guide it goes to `en/heroes/<slug>/#no-english-text`, where a notice appears (CSS `:target`).\n- **Root-absolute links:** `render_markdown` now drops `href`/`src` values starting with `/`, `//` or `\\`, in both the preview and the site.\n- **`.gitignore`:** `site/` → `/site/`, so `templates/site/` is tracked.\n- **Timestamps:** Guide timestamps are now stored to the millisecond.\n- **Tests:** `conftest` replaces the deploy step, so no test pushes.\n\nAlso in this branch (already pushed earlier): Exercise A (`decide()`), Exercise B (`spend()`), and transcript 06.\n\nReview findings and how each was resolved: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/5#issuecomment-6238282605\n\n## Evidence\n\n- **Before:** `render_site` wrote only `index.html` (\"Nothing published yet.\") and `style.css`.\n  **After:** rendering the seeded demo database writes 18 pages:\n  ```text\n  index.html, zh/index.html, en/index.html,\n  zh/guides/{mak-4,pygmalien-3}/, en/guides/mak-4/   # pygmalien-3 is Chinese-only\n  {zh,en}/heroes/{dooley,mak,pygmalien,vanessa}/, {zh,en}/authors/{1,2}/\n  ```\n- `tests/test_t04_site_build.py` adds 18 tests (Seam 2 for `render_site` output, Seam 1 for the button with the deploy step replaced). Examples:\n  ```text\n  test_draft_and_submitted_guides_never_appear_anywhere           PASS\n  test_no_generated_page_uses_a_root_absolute_path                PASS\n  test_script_in_a_guide_does_not_survive_the_site_build          PASS\n  test_a_failed_deploy_is_reported_and_the_changes_stay_pending   PASS\n  test_only_an_admin_can_update_the_site                          PASS\n  ```\n  Full suite: `139 passed`. `pyright`: 0 errors.\n\n## Merge Danger\n\n**Door:** two-way\n\nThe new `site_builds` table is additive (`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`), and the millisecond timestamps sort correctly against existing second-precision ones. Reverting the PR leaves only an unused table behind.\n\n**Blast Radius:** public-site\n\nEverything Readers see changes shape. The only thing that publishes is the 更新网站 button, which pushes to `gh-pages`. `cms deploy` now goes through the same `deploy()`. Known gap: the CLI path doesn't reset the dashboard count.\n\nCloses #5\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\nEOF\ngh pr create --base main --head Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2 --title \"T04: the Site build puts Published Guides online in Chinese and English\" --body-file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/8e04d881-36e8-4648-80fb-a97808a23dee/scratchpad/pr-body.md","description":"Push the branch and open the PR"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1778,"cache_read_input_tokens":194036,"output_tokens":1991,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":300},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1778,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1991,"cache_read_input_tokens":194036,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1778,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1778},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01T2jmGT24YFY3uPXCnoZ4jh":{"command":"git push -q origin HEAD 2>&1 | tail -2; cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/8e04d881-36e8-4648-80fb-a97808a23dee/scratchpad/pr-body.md <<'EOF'\n## Summary\n\nThe Site build now writes the public site from Published Guides, in Chinese and English. {"parentUuid":"d235ab63-776e-403e-b669-d20ae2eb247c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8FygbZQBgAFeq8FBQQL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I pushed the branch, opened PR #17, and merged it once GitHub showed it as mergeable (the repo has no CI checks to wait for). That closed #5. The PR also carried the Exercise A and B commits and transcript 06, which were already on the branch.\n\n**Your three questions:**\n1. **Pages is not enabled.** The Pages API returns 404 for the repo, and there is no `gh-pages` branch yet because nothing has ever been deployed. It should serve from `gh-pages` at `/ (root)`. The repo is public, so the free Pages setting works.\n2. **There is no real database, so there is no Published Guide.** Both `.env` files say `CMS_DATABASE=cms.db`, which is a path relative to the folder you start the console from. There is no `.db` file in your main checkout (`~/code/iphs400-mp2-cms`) or in this worktree.\n3. **Click 更新网站 rather than running the CLI commands.** The button builds the site, pushes it, records the update, and resets the \"N 项更改尚未更新到网站\" count. `cms publish` + `cms deploy` push the same site but leave the count stale.\n\n**What to do, in order:**\n1. **Update your main checkout.** It's clean but 15 commits behind, so it doesn't have T04 yet:\n   ```\n   cd ~/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && git pull\n   ```\n2. **Create the database with a Published Guide.** This seed script creates `cms.db` with two Published demo Guides (Mak in both languages, Pygmalien in Chinese only). It uses the passwords already in that folder's `.env`:\n   ```\n   uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py\n   ```\n3. **Start the console** with `uv run --env-file .env cms serve`. Sign in at `http://localhost:8000/login` as `admin@example.test`, then click **更新网站** on the dashboard. The push uses your normal git login from that terminal. If it fails, the dashboard shows git's error message.\n4. **Turn on Pages.** In the repo, go to Settings → Pages → Source: \"Deploy from a branch\" → `gh-pages`, folder `/ (root)`. This only works after step 3, because that's what creates the branch. Or run:\n   ```\n   ! gh api -X POST repos/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/pages -f \"source[branch]=gh-pages\" -f \"source[path]=/\"\n   ```\n5. **Wait a few minutes**, then open `https://avulpix0412.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/`.
